props.gloss_en: the mishnah: one may set the fire going in the bonfire of the Chamber of the Hearth [on Shabbat eve at nightfall]
Rav Huna: 'you shall kindle no fire in all your habitations' -- in all your habitations you may not kindle, but you may kindle in the bonfire of the Chamber of the Hearth
Rav Chisda: when the verse came, it came to permit [burning] limbs and fats
Rav Chisda: and the priests are vigilant -- [the ground for kindling the Chamber of the Hearth's bonfire at nightfall]

supports.gloss_en: מנהני מילי? אמר רב הונא: לא תבערו אש בכל מושבותיכם -- the verse offered as the source of the mishnah's permission (felled by Rav Chisda's objection)
וכהנים זריזין הן -- the mishnah permits it because the priests are vigilant, not from the verse

objections.gloss_en: מתקיף לה רב חסדא: אי הכי, אפילו בשבת נמי? -- if the verse permits kindling in the Chamber of the Hearth, it would be permitted even on Shabbat itself [not only at nightfall of its eve]
